summary: Executed focused backend+frontend regression for supplier GHG submission cadence/period APIs, resolver rules, lock semantics, and supplier/admin UI controls. Backend core cadence tests passed; auth CORS explicit-origin check still failing.

critical.issue: Returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*' instead of explicit trusted origin while credentials flow is expected.

ui_bugs.issue: Training checkbox append path uses document_requirement_ids array instead of training_requirement_ids, causing wrong payload composition when selecting trainings.

integration_issues.issue: Could not validate unlock dialog behavior end-to-end from /supplier-assessment/ghg because no unlock buttons/submitted supplier rows were present in current dataset.

action_items: Fix auth CORS config so trusted-origin preflight returns explicit origin (not wildcard) with credentials.
Fix SupplierList training assignment state update to append training IDs to training_requirement_ids (not document_requirement_ids).

Provide/seed one safely isolated submitted supplier period in preview data to allow non-destructive parent unlock modal runtime verification (reason required, optional instructions, no extra confirmation).
critical_code_review_comments: Custom-fuel direct POST regression path now returns safe 4xx (no 500) in executed test.
Cadence resolver maps monthly/quarterly/yearly as expected for FY Apr-Mar, and yearly data with non-yearly cadence is correctly rejected.
SupplierList.jsx line in add-training checkbox handler composes next state from current.document_requirement_ids, which is a real payload bug.
Parent unlock flow in SupplierGHGView uses a single dialog with required reason and optional instructions in code; runtime trigger blocked by missing submitted supplier rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Supplier submission screen verified nonblank at /supplier-assessment/emissions with yearly period ledger. Admin supplier edit dialog verified monthly/quarterly/yearly submission frequency controls. Parent unlock dialog runtime not exercised because no submitted supplier rows on /supplier-assessment/ghg. Pytest run: 9 passed, 1 failed (CORS explicit-origin), report: /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results_iter33_supplier_submission_cadence.xml.
rca of the issue: CORS failure repro: OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin=https://ghg-reporting-hub.preview.emergentagent.com returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*'. Root cause likely wildcard CORS middleware configuration conflicting with credentials-based explicit-origin requirement. Also identified frontend state bug: add-supplier training selection builds new training list from document_requirement_ids, mixing domains and sending incorrect assignment payload.
